synthesizedFacts.fact: Granuloma annulare is a benign skin condition characterized by raised, ring-shaped rashes or bumps.
The exact cause of granuloma annulare is unknown, but it may be triggered by minor skin injuries, infections, or certain medications.
Granuloma annulare is more common in women and can be associated with diabetes and thyroid diseases.
Treatment options include corticosteroid creams, injections, and phototherapy, but the condition often resolves on its own.
